metricDefinitions.ViewerInputAckRtt: performance.now at Input.recordLatency after successful socket.emit, controlled-send observation and transport trace, to LatencyMonitor.onInputAck after synchronous current-owner/controller ACK validation; same Viewer clock
metricDefinitions.ViewerInputToPostApplyFrame: same stored submitted clock to actual requestVideoFrameCallback now for a scope/RTP/SSRC matched fresh frame captured after application; late metadata joins retain original callback clock; not optical or application content proof
metricDefinitions.HostQueue: adapter-local perf_counter_ns entry to native-apply start; excludes outer Host InputAdmissionQueue wait
metricDefinitions.HostApply: adapter-local monotonic native start through native finish
metricDefinitions.HostAdapterAwait: Host perf_counter around awaited adapter method; includes adapter-local queue, excludes outer Host admission wait
metricDefinitions.SignalRequestToAck: Node performance.now after Host emit to after validated ACK emitted toward Viewer; both local directions plus Host and server work, not delivery to Viewer or pure network

directionAndBlindSpots.ViewerToSignal: not independently timed; includes public uplink and pre-noteForwarded Signal receive/validation/log work; no synchronized cross-process timestamp subtraction performed
directionAndBlindSpots.SignalToHostAndReturn: the existing same-Node-clock observer measures both directions as one 3.667-25.086ms interval including Host work; cannot divide its directions
directionAndBlindSpots.SignalToViewer: not independently timed; includes public downstream and browser dispatch/validation; Host/Signal enqueue does not prove receipt
directionAndBlindSpots.whatMagnitudeSupports: observed adapter durations below 2ms and local Signal-to-Host-ACK durations below 26ms are much smaller than the five known 405.5-496.3ms Viewer ACK values. Primary remaining cost lies outside the measured local Host round-trip bracket, but upstream versus downstream versus pre/post-bracket scheduling remains unresolved
directionAndBlindSpots.sameViewerEvidence: keyboard matched fresh post-apply frame callback precedes its validated ACK by 7.8-78.8ms. ACK and video use distinct paths; this demonstrates relative delivery timing only, not controlled visible effect
directionAndBlindSpots.unreconstructableValues: sampler exports only last/max/count, not all keyed samples. Five mouse RTTs and several mouse queue/apply/post-frame values are null with explicit upper bounds. They are not replaced by window maxima or paired by action without evidence.

optimizationLeads.candidate: Add bounded same-clock pre/post socket.emit and raw-ACK-arrival/validated-ACK timestamps for explicitly owned reset diagnostics, plus Signal handler-entry/after-Host-emit and Host-ACK-entry/after-Viewer-emit timestamps. Preserve authority, deadlines, payload privacy and protocol behavior.
optimizationLeads.why: Separates local observation and validation costs from public transport without cross-clock arithmetic.

optimizationLeads.candidate: Retain bounded per-input diagnostic scalar samples or action-associated unique sample summaries for the ten reset inputs, without raw IDs, keyboard contents or coordinates.
optimizationLeads.why: Current five-second last/max projection loses half of individual RTTs and cannot support a ten-input p95 or full per-action attribution.

optimizationLeads.candidate: Measure the already-established public Signal WebSocket path and its transport flush/drain/backpressure around these resets; compare explicit routes sequentially with load/context retained before changing routing.
optimizationLeads.why: All five sessions used WebSocket; do not assume polling POST or Host apply is the 400ms bottleneck. Existing public heartbeat RTT observations are corroborating path evidence with different scope, not a business-input substitute.

optimizationLeads.candidate: Evaluate reset batching or an already-authorized healthy data channel only as a separate protocol design and controlled experiment.
optimizationLeads.why: The current two resets are already issued without waiting for each other. Changing recovery transport must preserve current lease/source/sequence/reset proof, no replay and failure handling; cannot promise a gain from these observations alone.

forbiddenDerivations: No subtraction of Viewer and Host or Signal wall clocks for one-way delays.
No subtracting Host duration from Viewer RTT and labelling residual pure network.
No adding rolling p95/max values across metrics or snapshots.
No adding ACK RTT and post-apply-frame duration; they share the same Viewer send origin.
No counting 25 overlapping metric snapshots as 50 inputs.
No calling requestVideoFrameCallback or successful resets a visible-effect/business-input acceptance.
